title: A Jealous King, a Kind Heart
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The people sang of David's wins,
And Saul grew cross and mad.
"Why do they love him more than me?"
His heart grew dark and bad.

[Chorus]
Keep jealousy out of your heart,
And let God's love come in.
Be happy when your friend does well,
And that is how you win.

[Verse 2]
Saul threw a spear, it missed him twice,
For David ducked away.
He did not fight, he did not shout,
He just stayed kind that day.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes and breathe in deep,
Let all the grumbles go.
Heavenly Father loves you, child,
Much more than you can know.

[Chorus]
mood: Rocking music. A slow, even side-to-side sway holds under the voice, steady as a chair on a porch, keeping calm even where the story turns cross and jealous, so the child feels safe while the lesson lands. The chorus opens a little brighter, like a window letting fresh air into a stuffy room. By the last verse the sway drops lower and slower, until the grumbles are gone and only the soft rocking is left.
